scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Widow/Dependent in case of Death of a Worker- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow or dependent of the deceased worker
Deceased worker must have been employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Deceased worker must have been registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Application must be submitted within two years from the date of death of the worker
There is no maximum limit on the worker’s monthly salary
No fixed service period requirement for the worker
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 is provided to the widow or dependent of a deceased worker.
